current_canonical: V14 effect lifecycle + V15 presence + V16 execution continuity

steps.action: Preserve current negative receipts as baseline falsifiers
Keep V17 out of apply_current_schema canonical migration list
Require storage-level exact effect_id+attempt_id+verified outcome binding and exact REENTERED hash before DONE
Require exact current V15/V16 lease/execution-generation binding and stale-writer fencing
Require relationally closed GWT receiver use -> verified same-outcome causal credit -> admitted delta/no-learning -> support snapshot chain
Run target-VPS positive/negative differential, restart, hard-crash cutpoints, rollback, concurrency and replay tests
Measure p50/p95/p99, write/read amplification, RSS/storage, lock contention and recovery time against V14/V16 baseline
Only if correctness and recovery gates pass, add V17 to canonical migration chain in one reviewed change
Rerun exact-current end-to-end effect authority and UnifiedDB acceptance after canonical integration

rollback.candidate_prototype: DROP candidate V17 tables/triggers/meta/view objects as defined by the candidate rollback; V14/V15/V16 state remains intact
rollback.canonical_integration_if_later_promoted: Take verified checkpoint/backup before migration, run integrity+foreign_key_check, retain previous source/schema/artifact hashes, fail closed and restore last-known-good on mismatch
rollback.provider_effects: Never replay uncertain external effects merely because database rollback occurred; reconcile provider outcome first

sqlite_design_basis: Prefer additive candidate objects before parent-table rebuild because SQLite ALTER capabilities are deliberately limited and parent/FK changes can increase migration blast radius; this is an engineering choice, not a universal database rule.
keep_isolated: vector/activation/ranking indexes until measured consolidation benefit exists
